newsitem.title: KENYA: Burundi ex-president Bagaza under house arrest.
newsitem.headline: Burundi ex-president Bagaza under house arrest.

text.p: Burundi's hardline ex-president Jean-Baptiste Bagaza was released from custody on Monday and is being held under house arrest, senior government officials said on Monday.

Bagaza, an ethnic Tutsi who was ousted from power in 1987, was detained and questioned on Sunday after police and internal security raided his house and found guns, grenades and subversive papers, the officials said.
"He (Bagaza) has been released but he is under house arrest," a senior government official told Reuters.

Burundi's current leader Pierre Buyoya, who took power in a military coup last July, had also ousted Bagaza from power in 1987. Since last July's coup Bagaza has been fiercely critical of Buyoya's regime.

"The government cannot tolerate people who oppose its programme of peace and reconciliation. If he is going to be charged he will be charged by the magistrate under common law," Information Minister Pierre-Claver Ndayicariye said by telephone from the Burundian capital Bujumbura.
